{{Quote|The AAT serves as the Trade Federation's front line assault vehicle. Designed to wipe out enemy troops, the AAT boasts a powerful laser cannon capable of punching through enemy ranks. A fearsome sight on any battlefield, the AAT is one of the Trade Federation's most formidable weapons.|Captain Panaka|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''</ref>}}
The '''Armored Assault Tank''' ('''AAT-1''' or '''AAT''') was a medium-sized [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] [[Tank/Legends|tank]] used mainly by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] prior to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The tank had heavy frontal armor that gave it the capability to plow through walls, and it was heavily armed with a payload of 57 shells. The tank required a crew of four [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to be fully operated and was able to carry six additional battle droids onto the battlefield. The tank's reactor and power and communications gear were kept in the rear for protection.

The vehicle was designed by the [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor]] factories, with its most important parts placed in the back. [[Pilot/Legends|Piloted]] by [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|OOM pilot battle droids]], AATs comprised a significant portion of the Trade Federation's ground forces. They were used to fight armies of pirates in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] before they were finally deployed in the Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Ten years later they would be used heavily during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Though AATs did see a little action after the Republic transformed into the Galactic Empire in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], these instances were very rare.

==Description==
[[File:AAT_ep1ig.png|thumb|left|180px|AAT cross-section.]]
The Armored Assault Tank was a formidable vehicle; it was augmented with heavy inches-thick frontal armor that allowed it to plow through walls, and had heavy weaponry. It carried a payload of 57 shells, but once exhausted, the AAT had to return to its carrier to have its shovel-shaped lower hull completely replaced, fully replenishing its supply.<ref name="CCS" />

The AAT's [[Energy shell launcher|launch tubes]] could be equipped with a variety of ammunition. The three standard-issue ammunition types were "[[bunker-buster]]s," high explosive shells used for destroying enemy structures such as outposts; armor-piercing shells, used for penetrating heavy armor on tanks; and high-[[energy shell]]s for anti-personnel and anti-vehicle use. As they were fired, these shells were surrounded by high-energy plasma, which improved their penetration and reduced friction, thus increasing speed.<ref name="CCS" />

[[File:AAT2_negvv.jpg|thumb|left|180px|AAT [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]].]]
Its crew consisted of four [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] (one [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|commander]], one pilot, and two [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]]), and could also carry six [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] on the hand grips on the outside of the tank.<ref name="CCS" /> The commander typically sat inside the turret of the primary [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannon, while the gunners and pilot were positioned in the main hull of the tank. The gunners operated both secondary blasters, and the commander controlled the main turret.<ref name="CCS" /> The droid's [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] allowed for only simple tactics, but the tank was effective nonetheless.<ref name="EGW" />

The reactor, along with key power and communications gear, was kept in the rear for protection, as with many other Baktoid vehicles.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> The AAT used heavy-duty [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] to keep it off the ground and propel it forward.<ref name="CCS" /> While this method was relatively quick, it was sluggish compared to the [[V-19 landspeeder|Gian]] and [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash speeders]] of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="CCS" /> and the later [[Ground Armored Tank|GAT]].<ref name="SW: THC" /> Like other repulsorlift vehicles, the Armored Assault Tank was unable to penetrate [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].<ref name="EGW" />

Enemy forces could destroy an Armored Assault Tank by dropping [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|EMP]] or [[Thermal detonator/Legends|explosive]] [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] into both the main turret and the pilot hatch.<ref name="TCW:AWOTF">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref> Additionally, the tanks were vulnerable to portable [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]],<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> other vehicles,<ref name="SW: THC" /> or [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="TCW:Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>

==History==
===Pre-Clone Wars===
[[File:AAT.jpg|thumb|left|200px|AATs at the Battle of Grassy Plains]]
Prior to its most notable use in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the AAT-1 was deployed by the Trade Federation to several [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds, engaging them in battles against each other, to prove that they had both battle-scars and battle-readiness. When the Invasion of Naboo had started, the AATs had already engaged in fierce combat against armies of pirates, proving that the tank was ready for war.<ref name="CCS" /> Trade Federation strategy dictated that two AATs escort an MTT.<ref name="Expanded VD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
[[File:AATs-Great-Grass-Plains.png|thumb|right|300px|AATs at the Battle of Naboo]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the AAT was one of the primary vehicles used in the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo, and was deployed throughout the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], where their maneuvers caused damage to many buildings.<ref name="SW: CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> AATs were instrumental in securing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and fought in [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|other important battles]] of the invasion. During the course of the invasion, commander [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] ordered the creation of additional units at [[Factory/Legends|mech factories]].<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> Notably, two Jedi [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] stole an AAT to [[Capture of Theed/Legends|fight their way]] through Theed to reach Naboo's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. AATs also battled the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] on Naboo's [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|open fields]].<ref name="SW:JPB">[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'']]</ref> Droid commander [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] led the battle against the Gungans from an AAT. As a result of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] destroying the Federation's [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]], they were left in their final battle positions when the Trade Federation's droid forces were deactivated and were thus captured by the Naboo.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

A heavy variant of the AAT known as the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Heavy AAT]] also engaged in battle during the Invasion of Naboo.<ref name="SW:GB" />

===Clone Wars===
[[File:Yoda_targeted.png|thumb|left|200px|An AAT's targeting system targets [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]]]]
Shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and hence AATs were assimilated into the rapidly growing Confederate armies. During the assimilation process, they were all repainted with the CIS standard blue and gray paint scheme and fitted with heavier double laser cannons on the flanking turrets. They would see action during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle of the war]], and would be used extensively during the [[Dark Reaper]] [[Dark Reaper crisis|crisis]],<ref name="SW: THC" /> as well as the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]].

On the planet [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], AATs were used under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] and many of the tanks were destroyed during the battle by the Republic's [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Cannon]].<ref name="SW: CW">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''</ref>

The [[HAG-M|Heavy Artillery Gun]], also used during the war, had a design similar to that of the AAT.

During the war, they showed vulnerability to [[PLX-1/Legends|PLX-1 portable missile launcher]] fire, with a single missile from this capable of destroying it if aimed at the correct location. [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] also displayed capability of jumping inside the tank and blasting it apart from the inside.<ref name="SW: CW" /> Also, they seemed inferior to the Republic [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]].<ref name="SW: THC" />

During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], many AATs were deployed for use by the Geonosian Rebels against the Republic Forces. Later, after his defeat, [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Archduke Poggle the Lesser]] used a damaged AAT to transport supplies to the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]].

[[File:SepAAT-TCWIV.png|thumb|right|200px|An AAT in the service of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
The AAT-1 also saw action during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] alongside [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|Octuptarra combat tri-droids]],<ref name="SW: CW" /> and on a multitude of other worlds, including [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]],<ref name="SW: THC" /> [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Aargonar/Legends|Aargonar]],<ref name="Republic">''[[Star Wars: Republic: The Battle of Jabiim]]''</ref> [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]],<ref name="Defenders of Peace">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref> and [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]].<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

===Aftermath===
However, following the [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] would sometimes utilize AATs during a few battles in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] (possibly including the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tatooine]]).<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds" />

One AAT was refurbished and made serviceable during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by a former Imperial slave [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] named [[Quagga]]. It then saw service during [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's demolition games|gladiatorial game]].<ref name="Demolition" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Armored Assault Tank in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] brings to life the concept of an [[Imperial Air Tank|Imperial air tank]] from [[The Star Wars rough draft|''The Star Wars: Rough Draft'']].<ref name="TSW1">[[The Star Wars 1|''The Star Wars'' 1]]</ref> The revised rough draft script of Episode I described the Trade Federation invasion spearheaded by AACs, or Armored Attack Craft. George Lucas' original design ideas for the battle tank resembled more of an assault helicopter: a low-flying armored gun. As the design developed, the AAT began to draw more tank-like characteristics, as well as animalistic qualities (the arm-mounted cannons, for instance, suggest claws and horns). The forward curve of the tank was inspired by the design of a shovel.<ref name="DB-Trade Federation AAT Armored Assault Tank">{{DB|vehicle|tfed_aat|Trade Federation AAT (Armored Assault Tank)}}</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', AATs were going to be part of both the Separatist and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] faction. The Imperial variant was cut from the final version, but its code remained hidden in the game's source. Some fans managed to unearth it and restored them to functional status.<ref name="Filefront">{{WebCite|url=https://www.gamefront.com/games/star-wars-battlefront/file/prototype-iaat|text=Prototype IAAT|author=PR-0927/Majin Revan|date=2005-05-23|work=[[Wikipedia:GameFront|GameFront]]|archivedate=20251218173017}}</ref>

In the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]], AATs serve as the "mech destroyer" unit for the Trade Federation. Players are provided them in several missions of the campaign, and more may be built at mech factories for 100 units of food and 175 units of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]].

In ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'', the AAT is missing its anti-personnel blaster cannons. It is also missing the two gunners. Instead, it is manned by a commander and pilot.
